title: Apple signs chipmaking agreement with GlobalFoundries in New York

sources.quote: GlobalFoundries and Apple have also entered an agreement to bring more semiconductor manufacturing to the United States, focused on manufacturing cutting-edge wireless technologies and advanced power management — critical technologies that enable longer battery life and enhanced connectivity in Apple devices.

explain: Apple agreed to have GlobalFoundries make wireless and power-management chips for Apple devices at GF's fab in Malta, New York, part of Apple's $600 billion US investment pledge. The value was not disclosed.
